messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: increased OOM rate observed on paged-attn allocator (kv-cache) in us-west-2. Affected pool: r-infer-pool-3. Symptoms: gradual resident set growth -> CUDA resets. Auto-scaler triggered restarts.

mike: ack. I'm oncall, starting triage. tagging @sara and @raj.

sara: on it. quick check: dashboards show steady mem creep on allocator slab usage for ~2.5h. 95th latency for /generate in us-west up ~120ms and error rate +503s about 3.8%.

raj: seeing repeated logs from allocator: `kv_paged: free_region_count dropping below low_watermark`, and node kube logs show `OOMKilled` + `containerd: runtime: failed to get event due to cuda driver reset`. snippet: ```
May 1 12:03:47 r-infer-05 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 12876 (python) score 987 or sacrifice child
May 1 12:03:47 r-infer-05 dockerd: container killed: exit_code=137, reason="oom"
```

lee: confirmed r-infer-05 and r-infer-06 have repeated cuda: GPU watchdog resets. r-infer-03 looks noisy but still serving.

mike: mitigation options: 1) set routing policy to divert 30% of us-west traffic to quantized smaller model (quant-v2) 2) force-evict KV caches on noisy nodes 3) cordon+drain the worst node and bounce allocator process. Which first?

sara: do #1 immediately to reduce P95 and token pressure. I'll open a fallback route: `route:set --region us-west --model quant-v2 --pct 30 --reason "OOM mitigation"`.

raj: while Sara flips that, I'm preparing a targeted cache-evict script to drop hot prefixes on r-infer-05/06. quick command: ```
kubectl exec -n inference r-infer-05 -- /usr/local/bin/kvctl evict --prefix hot:
```

mike: run the evict on r-infer-06 first. then if node still OOMing, drain r-infer-06 and restart the allocator service. leave r-infer-05 up as canary.

lee: started evict on r-infer-06 now. results: reclaimed ~7.2GB from KV pool, slab fragmentation metric down 8%.

incident-bot: NOTE: route update applied by sara at 1719902550.

sara: route update done. monitoring shows immediate drop in token concurrency for heavy endpoints. error rate trending down to 2.1%.

raj: r-infer-06 still had a cuda reset ~4m after evict, but subsequent restarts are stable. suspect slow page leak in allocator upstream (paged-attn codepath). grabbing heap dumps for postmortem.

mike: good. customer impact: CS reports 2 low-priority customer complaints about increased latency earlier but no billing/regulatory issues. tagging support for follow-up.

lee: I've created incident: INC-2024-5543 (ops) with notes and attached heap traces and logs.

mike: action items: - raj to collect full heap dumps + PCI dump from affected nodes (r-infer-05/06) - eng-runtime to prioritize a small patch to aggressively free stale KV pages (PR incoming) - ops to schedule rolling bounce for r-infer-pool-3 during low traffic window - sara to keep route fallback at 30% until patch deployed.

raj: uploading dumps to /mnt/incidents/INC-2024-5543/; will open a runtime PR with reproducer and mitigation flags (kv_evict_threshold override).

mike: handing off in 25m to @jordan for overnight watch. Jordan, I'll leave watch doc in the incident ticket with metrics and runbook: if error rate >3% restore further fallback to 50% and start emergency drain.

jordan: taking over. thanks. I'll monitor and escalate if instability returns. :thumbsup:

mike: closing active triage for now. leave postmortem assignment to eng-runtime + oncall rotation. :white_check_mark:
